findings.truth: The deck rule wants a single-word answer only where the question opens What/Which/Who/When/Name. This is the pre-retrofit card shape, shared with other units, and a reshape is a deck job rather than a fact fix. Recorded, not edited.

summary: One high finding: the lesson 4 matching check offers the same option text twice, and the player marks by index, so a correct pairing can be marked wrong. The rest are the exam board named in student-facing prose across five lessons, two exam claims the spec does not support, nine cover-and-recall prompts pointing at boxes that hold something else, and three filler flashcards that repeated an earlier answer. Every definition, list and answer key was checked against the spec's own lists and all of them are right.
